scope: BOUNDED_CANDIDATE_QUALIFICATION; no per-character/detail/cycle/Profiler timing; full Driver GC, post-Driver checksum/input/RNG and raw progress parity; not H07 or Android certification.

cpuCalibration.units: elapsed=Stopwatch ticks; CPU time=GetThreadTimes 100ns units (resolution not asserted); cycles=raw QueryThreadCycleTime, never converted to ms

progressBinaryLayout: 300 tick-major rows; each row capacity*35 bytes; ascending runtime slots, 1 presence byte then canonical17 then runtime17. Fields: CdAttack,CdJump,CdDefend,CdDefendLock,CdRight,CdLeft,CdUp,CdDown,ComboDra,ComboDla,ComboDua,ComboDda,ComboDrj,ComboDlj,ComboDuj,ComboDdj,ComboDja. Aborted rows beyond evidence.ticks are unwritten zero arrays.
